issues.problem: Official code has no eval script; README trains with `-s` only, i.e. `images` + `-r -1` (auto-resize to 1600 px wide, = mipnerf360-1600). images_4/2 is an inference, not documented.
issues.evidence: source/code/README.md 'python train.py -s <path>'; utils/camera_utils.py:24-33 (-1 -> 1600 width). Supp. 3DGS LPIPS row (.205/.332/.107/.213/.326/.219/.200/.127/.204) is within ~0.01 of the 3DGS paper's images_4/2 per-scene LPIPS; our gsplat 1600 runs are 0.02-0.04 LPIPS worse than images_4 outdoors (bicycle .281 vs .243, garden .153 vs .131), so the images_4/2 assumption is the better-supported one.
issues.fix: Keep `mipnerf360` (images_4/2) as primary; state the evidence in report.md; optionally run garden on mipnerf360-1600 as a sensitivity check against baseline3dgs-mipnerf360-1600-30000.

issues.problem: Atom scale P1 is computed from runtime exact 3-NN (cdist) distances; official uses simple-knn distCUDA2 (approximate box-search KNN, can over-estimate distances), so S0 may differ slightly.
issues.evidence: splatstudio runtime.py:100-107 knn_log_scales vs official gaussian_model.py:130-132 distCUDA2
issues.fix: Record as a fidelity gap (small); no change required.

issues.problem: Optimizer step precedes densify/atomize/reset (official: replaced tensors skip that iteration's Adam step: all fields every densify, scales every atomize, opacity every reset). Already listed as gap 1.

No probe asserts densification continues in 7000-15000 (split at full 2e-4, clone, prunes, 300-step resets) and stops at 15000 for densify; config is correct (densify_until_iter 15000) but a regression to 7000 would only partly be caught (reset at 15000 checked, densify not).
issues.fix: Add a step-14900 densify / step-15000 no-densify assertion.

issues.problem: Paper deltas on the requested scenes are tiny (garden +0.26, room +0.08 dB vs its 3DGS row); room is within seed noise, so the benchmark can hardly confirm or refute the method. Our baseline room (31.52) already exceeds the paper's AtomGS room (31.30).
issues.fix: Judge on delta vs baseline3dgs-mipnerf360-30000; consider adding bicycle (+0.23) for a second outdoor data point.

issues.problem: After step 7000 depth_to_normal is still computed every step and back-propagated with zero weight (compute/memory cost only, no numerical effect).
issues.fix: Optional: skip surface_normal computation after `until` (speed only).

summary: Faithful port. Kernel byte-identical to the official submodule; density, atomize, reset, LR, photometric and normal losses match official train.py/gaussian_model.py/arguments operator by operator, including split-before-clone and the clone index shift. Densification runs to 15000 (not 7000): split threshold warms to 2e-4 by 7000, atomize and the normal loss stop at 7000, opacity resets every 300 until 15000, consistent with the official defaults. Smoke trajectory (7.0M plateauing at 1.9k on garden) matches the supp. proliferation curve shape (peak ~2.4k then decline to ~0.55x by 15k); expect garden peak ~7.5M, final ~4-6M; 15M cap and --min-free-gb 16 suffice. Approved with minors only.
